dynastyprocess.scoring_note: one value set for every scoring format

rules.balance: Position balance: share of value that would have to move between positions to match the projections (ESPN, CBS rest-of-season, Razzball run through our model), Half PPR, 12 teams. Strong up to 5 points, OK up to 10, Weak above 10.
rules.consolidation: 2-for-1 sense: the share of mid-tier pairs (ranks 25-60) that the raw chart says beat a top-12 player, minus the share once each player's waiver-level value is subtracted. Strong up to 10 points of difference, OK up to 25, Weak above 25.
rules.depth: Depth: the thinnest position's listed players as a share of the players a 12-team league rosters there. Strong at 100% or more, OK at 70% or more, Weak below.
rules.freshness: Freshness: Strong when each of the four week-to-week changes from week 5 to 9 is a new publication and moves last week's top 24 per position by at least a quarter of a rank on average; OK when one week did not; Weak otherwise.
rules.league_size: League size: Strong when the source offers its own numbers by team count; Weak with one table for every league size.
rules.scoring: Scoring formats: compare Standard with Full PPR for the top 36 at RB, WR and TE. Strong when at least 20% of those players change places on average; OK when the numbers change but fewer change places; Weak when the numbers do not change.
rules.superflex: Superflex: Strong with superflex values for 24 or more QBs (two per team); OK with fewer; Weak with none.
